brief.ending: iris closes on Dou hugging the persimmon

style.notes: dusk orchard; the persimmon is the only saturated warm colour

shots.visual: wide: the bare tree at dusk, one persimmon; Dou trots in from the left and stops under it
shots.camera: locked wide; iris in on the persimmon

reads.read: the persimmon (the iris holds on it)
an orchard at dusk opens around it
a small creature trots in under the tree

shots.visual: medium: Dou turns, looks up, wants the fruit, jumps and misses by a hair, lands, sulks
shots.camera: cut on the turn; locked medium

reads.read: it looks up and sees the persimmon (!)
it wants it: sparkling eyes, a bounce
it crouches: a jump is coming
the jump misses by a hair, held at the top
it sulks; the first leaves blow in

shots.visual: the same framing, pushing in: a gust, the persimmon drops on Dou's head, bounces into its arms; joy
shots.camera: no cut: the medium framing carries on and pushes in slowly; iris out on the pair

reads.read: a gust: leaves blow, the fruit wobbles (Dou does not see)
the iris closes on the two
